sources.snippet: Cardiac contour segmentation is a central step in quantitative cardiac MRI analysis. Delineating the endocardium and epicardium makes it possible to estimate ventricular cavity and myocardial wall regions, which are used downstream for functional measurements and anatomical interpretation.
